Name: insert_defaults
SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT  UNION ALL SELECT ) AS data WHERE true), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."defaults" SELECT  FROM check_mutation_result RETURNING *) SELECT json_build_object('affected_rows', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mutation_result), 'returning', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_e")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT mutation_result."id" AS "id", mutation_result."label" AS "label" FROM mutation_result) AS "_e"))
